digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The day produced clearer ownership for Amazon Connect, but the dashboard's checklist status has not refreshed since October 8. Tomorrow is meeting-heavy, with manager reviews due and launch readiness still needing attention.

items.label: Confirm Denver go-live and close the Amazon Connect operating gaps
items.detail: Confirm Denver's release result and Thursday readiness for Houston and Austin. Duvan stepped back as the primary Product contact, with Dolapo, Sinery, and Sebastian supporting the work; the call-and-ticket availability question, voicemail access, offboarding coverage, and PTO redirection still need clear owners.

items.label: Close the Attorney Review routing decision
items.detail: Confirm whether the five-to-eight-minute routing delay will be fixed for the October 19 launch. If not, approve the direct-assignment workaround, name the designated attorneys, and close the remaining script work.

items.label: Complete the three remaining manager reviews
items.detail: HR identified Nicolas, Astrid, and Armando as still incomplete. Submit all three by Thursday, October 15.

items.label: Resolve the critical Supabase row-level-security finding
items.detail: Validate the affected project and restore the intended access policy for the public table.

items.label: Secure Legal review capacity for EKM scripts
items.detail: Confirm the Legal owner, available capacity, and review priority so the script queue does not delay the EKM migration or Agentforce readiness.

items.label: Resolve the overdue Q3 Legacy Award nomination
items.detail: Confirm whether the nomination was submitted; if not, get a firm answer on whether a late entry can still be accepted.

items.label: Confirm the lawsuit-readiness document request is closed
items.detail: Verify that the process map and supporting links satisfy Kris's request, then send any missing SOPs, policies, training materials, or folder locations.

items.label: Close the NTA deployment follow-up
items.detail: Today's email confirms UAT was approved and the request is in production and closed. Confirm there is no remaining appointment-reminder handoff, then close the dashboard follow-up.

items.label: Close the executive portfolio slide update
items.detail: Verify that the source deck matches the October 12 version circulated Tuesday, then close the task or correct any stale status and date.

items.label: Set the Product path for the Mental Health Evaluation and Detention Prevention work
items.detail: Define the process, system, ownership, and intake requirements for nationwide MHE vendor expansion and for Detention Prevention edge cases that may require Litify changes, training, SOPs, or Legal alignment.

items.label: Amazon Connect Product support changed hands
items.detail: Duvan stepped back as the primary Product contact. Dolapo, Sinery, and Sebastian will support Amazon Connect moving forward.

items.label: 10:00 AM - Astrid 1:1
items.detail: Use the opening conversation to clear any review input and portfolio follow-ups before the Amazon Connect standup.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Review Denver's first-day outcome and confirm Houston and Austin readiness, including user skills, deployment ownership, and the Product handoff.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Armando 1:1
items.detail: Close any remaining review input before the noon work block.

items.label: Noon - Final manager-review work window
items.detail: Use the protected hour to finish and submit the three remaining reviews due Thursday.

items.label: 1:30 PM - Operations Portfolio Review
items.detail: Bring Phase I, Phase II, and Court decisions, stalled owners, and newly visible launch risks. The session overlaps the 2:00 PM Knowledge Management assignments review.

items.label: 2:30 PM - Attorney Review conflicts with Maria 1:1
items.detail: Choose coverage in advance so the launch decisions and Maria's portfolio roadblocks both receive a clear follow-up.

items.label: 3:30 PM and 4:00 PM - Thiago 1:1, then Tudo Bem weekly meeting
items.detail: Use the back-to-back sessions to lock Amazon Connect owners and remove the roadblocks surfaced in the day's launch and portfolio checkpoints.
